criterion_text: `submit` inputs one prompt only into the verified idle Claude Session and returns its actual `conversation_id` and truthful delivery status; mismatch/unknown/concurrent/timeout replay does not cause an unchecked second submission.

verifiers.summary: the submit delivery/identity contracts are pinned in source; the live verifier delivers one real prompt and reads it back from the same conversation

evidence.value: submit requires the verified conversation_id, refuses an empty/blank guard and empty/multi-line prompts before any input, refuses a foreign Agent target, and reports the delivery phase (`input_sent`) with the actual conversation id rather than an execution result

verifiers.summary: a real Claude CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code) received exactly one prompt in one verified conversation, reported input_sent with that exact id, recorded the prompt and reply, and refused stale and waiting submissions without delivering them
